# Arthur Sabintsev

> Physicist, engineer, and two-time founder. Co-founder of Modern Intelligence (defense AI). Previously co-founder & CEO of Grove, the team behind Pocket Network. Took the POKT token past a $1B+ market cap. Contact: arthur.sabintsev@gmail.com.

## About
Arthur Ariel Sabintsev is a physicist turned engineer turned founder (Washington DC–Baltimore). He left a fully funded experimental nuclear physics PhD track (Jefferson Lab / GW) to build products. He co-founded [Modern Intelligence](https://modernintelligence.ai) — defense AI spanning automatic target recognition (ATR), terminal guidance, counter-UAS / counter-UAV (C-UAS, CUAS, CUAV), and total domain awareness. Previously he co-founded [Grove](https://grove.city), the team behind [Pocket Network](https://pocket.network)—trillion+ API requests, POKT past a $1B+ market cap—and later agentic micropayments (USDC / x402). Writes on AI agents, stablecoins, and operator craft on [Substack](https://artsabintsev.substack.com). Full bio: [llms-full.txt](https://sabintsev.com/llms-full.txt).
